Yud-Tes Kislev.summary: The 19th of Kislev marks the liberation of the Alter Rebbe, Rabbi Schneur Zalman of Liadi, founder of Chabad Chassidus, from Czarist imprisonment in 1798. Celebrated as the Rosh Hashana of Chassidus.

Yud Shvat.summary: The 10th of Shvat marks the yahrtzeit of the Frierdiker Rebbe, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Schneersohn (1950), and the day the Lubavitcher Rebbe, Rabbi Menachem Mendel Schneerson, formally accepted the nesius of Chabad-Lubavitch in 1951.

Hey Tammuz.summary: The 5th of Tammuz marks the miraculous rescue of the Lubavitcher Rebbe's library by Soviet authorities in 1987. Celebrated as a day of victory for Torah.

Yud-Beis Tammuz.summary: The 12th of Tammuz marks the liberation of the Frierdiker Rebbe, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Schneersohn, from Soviet imprisonment in 1927. He refused to cease teaching Torah even under threat of death.

Yud-Gimmel Tammuz.summary: The 13th of Tammuz: the Frierdiker Rebbe departed the Soviet Union in 1927, completing his liberation. Celebrated together with Yud-Beis Tammuz.

Chof Av.summary: The 20th of Av marks the yahrtzeit of Rabbi Levi Yitzchak Schneerson, father of the Lubavitcher Rebbe, who suffered greatly for his efforts to strengthen Yiddishkeit in Soviet Russia.

Chof-Daled Teves.summary: The 24th of Tevet marks the yahrtzeit of the Alter Rebbe, Rabbi Schneur Zalman of Liadi (1812), founder of Chabad Chassidus and author of the Tanya and Shulchan Aruch HaRav.
